## 双向互动承接

修复小说中对白、无声动作和叙述者自身回应容易漏审的问题。分别追踪同一回合的言语与动作，确认受影响的人是否已经接收、拒绝、受阻或明确延迟回应；保留含蓄承接，避免每句强行添加动作。

- 小说生成与改写按需识别人际动作，复用 voice 模块。
- 自动流水线与长篇深度审查覆盖无声互动；跨块待回应项目交由统稿确认。
- 更新中英文 README、Skill 入口与 SkillHub 中文概述。
- 163 项自动测试通过，保留原有提示词预算；独立模型试审覆盖缺失回应、隐含完成、拒绝和跨块不确定性。

## Bidirectional Interaction Uptake

Track each affected participant and separate simultaneous speech and action obligations. Preserve implied completion and evidenced delay; do not assume acceptance, contact, or following from an initiator's action alone.

On-demand generation, automatic pipelines, and deep chunk audits now route directed wordless interactions. Reconciliation checks pending responses across chunk boundaries. Serious documents remain outside automatic fiction-interaction routing.

Validated with 163 automated tests and a focused independent model review. Contextual response assessment is model-executed; these checks do not guarantee detection of every omission.
Exclude Cursor editor-rule files from the SkillHub upload bundle. The GitHub repository retains the Cursor template; SkillHub receives only supported runtime and documentation files.

## Narrative repetition and exposition audit

- Add a narrative-only audit for exact echoes, repeated action choreography, inventory drift, and redundant explanatory narration.
- Add the repetition isolated audit profile and a signal-gated long-form pipeline pass.
- Keep quick humanization and serious-document workflows free of this narrative-only cost.
- Add deterministic lint findings REP001, NAT005, and NAT006, with allow-list support.
- Update English and Chinese guidance and packaging coverage.

## Dialogue naturalness

- Added dialogue-performance-audit for listener uptake, purposeful physical beats, and earned dialogue landings in fiction and webnovels.
- Explicit interaction requests such as reunion, testing, reconciliation, confrontation, negotiation, and dialogue activate the detailed modules on demand; narration-only and serious documents do not.
- Automatic pipeline review now recognizes a real two-turn exchange; default full review remains lightweight.

## Reliability

- The full ending module remains explicitly gated; ai-trace and default full review keep the lightweight END001 preflight.
- Local skill resources are covered by tests before packaging.
- Chinese and English documentation plus SkillHub discovery text now cover dialogue audit, dialogue action audit, and natural character interaction.

## Highlights

- Adds an earned-ending audit for Chinese and English AI-style reflective bookends, scenic dissolves, false closure, stock kickers, and meaningless uplift after the last real scene change.
- Adds deterministic END001 evidence spans for narrative exits, with deletion-first repair and allowlisting.
- Uses separate ending contracts for fiction/webnovels, hard news/features, academic/technical writing, and official documents.
- Adds executable chunk-audit for cross-month and cross-model style unification, character consistency, dialogue voice, terminology, and continuity.
- Keeps token use controlled: the full ending module is explicit/on-demand; automatic pipelines avoid duplicating it when ai-trace already covers the pass.
- Improves English GitHub/ClawHub discovery and Chinese SkillHub discovery for AI story ending, scene ending audit, AI式结尾, 生硬结尾审查, 伪收束, 无意义升华, 长篇审查, and 文风统一.

Fixes automated review findings for the narrative naturalness audit.

## v0.10.6

### Added
- Added the on-demand `narrative-naturalness-audit` module for deep or explicit AI-trace review of fiction, webnovels, and narrative self-media.
- Added deterministic `NAT001`-`NAT004` findings for repeated scene-entry recipes, vague-affect recurrence, abstract paragraph closures, and clustered pressure-bearing dialogue without visible uptake.

### Guardrails
- Quick humanization remains unchanged and does not load the new module.
- Serious academic, legal, technical, formal, and news writing remains isolated from narrative naturalness rules.
- Deep humanize prompt stays under the existing 30,000-character budget.
- The audit improves prose quality and continuity; it does not promise detector evasion or authorship classification results.

### Validation
- 113 tests passed locally.
- GitHub Actions passed on Python 3.9, 3.10, and 3.12.

## English

- Improved SkillHub Chinese title, summary, description, and search tags.

## 中文

- 新增 `speech-register-continuity`：按人物经历、共同语言、听众、敬语、语气词和变调依据生成与审核对白，防止方言、外语和人物口吻串台。
- 新增 `capability-state-audit`：区分永久战力/能力与临时伤势、装备、资源、冷却、克制和权限，要求变化与意外结果具备过程门和代价。
- 新增 `formal-document` 基础文体，区分小说口语、公文、新闻与论文的语气密度，并为公文启用严肃文本保护。
- 长篇上下文采用“权威账本 -> 最新状态 -> 近期章节 -> 相关旧片段 -> 不确定推断”的证据顺序，检索片段不能覆盖后续确认状态。
- 新模块继续按需加载：`register` 只在对白与语言/身份证据同时存在时激活；`capability` 自动审查需要上下文；普通文戏不承担额外 Token。
- 延长 ClawHub 最终一致性等待窗口，减少实际发布成功但 Action 误报失败的情况。

- Adds evidence-gated speech register and language-identity continuity for dialects, honorifics, particles, address forms, and code-switching.

- Adds a formal-document base style and separates conversational fiction from official, news, and academic register.
- Defines a layered long-form context order so retrieved older passages cannot overwrite newer canonical state.
- Keeps the new modules demand-loaded to preserve Token budgets.

Initial release of human-writing-skills.

- Supports writing, rewriting, and auditing natural, genre-aware long-form prose.
- Ensures physical, relationship, and fact continuity; enables protected fact verification and deterministic pattern linting.
- Workflow includes modular style selection and explicit handling of style calibration from user-supplied samples.
- Provides commands for building, auditing, linting, and verifying manuscripts across fiction, webnovels, essays, news, self-media, and academic prose.
- Comprehensive user and developer documentation referenced in README and docs.
